codeReview.summary: The decomposition of SocialInteractionsModSettings into 5 nested IExposable classes (ApiSettings, FeatureToggles, PromptSettings, DisplaySettings, GameplaySettings) is correctly implemented. All 134 Scribe keys are preserved exactly (verified by extracting keys from both old and new versions). Both enums (LlmApiType with 10 values, TtsApiType with 2 values) are preserved in original order. The top-level class retains ModSettings inheritance and version tracking. ExposeData() correctly delegates to all 5 nested classes. All 51 consumer files across Api/, Core/, Patches/, Jobs/, Speech/, Dating/, Interactions/, Negotiation/, Combat/, UI/, and Children/ directories are updated to use the nested Settings.Api.X / Settings.Features.X / Settings.Prompts.X / Settings.Display.X / Settings.Gameplay.X access pattern. No legacy direct field accesses remain. DoSettingsWindowContents compiles and correctly references nested settings. Build succeeded with 0 errors, all 24 tests pass.
